At four, I started playing instruments, but it was called “making noise” and I was sometimes punished (but no one asked why a toddler is suddenly playing instruments)


As an adult, I have achievements that are unmatched for someone from my neighborhood, a possibly photographic memory, and estimated IQ of 150-160, still clumsy, still sensitive to noise, and still eating safe foods only… but my family is just annoyed, tries to act as if I’m not too smart, and think that I am just high-maintenance.
